title: Jib Down
description: A jib down camera is a short descending arm, a few feet of boom, intimate arrival with nearby foreground sliding as the camera sits down. It is a small crane, not a city-scale drop.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: A full crane is too much city. Sit down into the talk: a table, a face, a huddle.
You drop from standing-eye or a little above into the scene like a guest sitting down. An aerial of a fortress wants a crane.
A tilt down from a locked tripod has no sliding foreground. Speed is polite unless you say otherwise.
Do not travel a city block.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Short jib, remote or operator on the arm, start a little high, end at the subject. Nearby foreground (glasses, a lamp, a railing) should parallax.
Prompt: Jib down onto [Subject], a short descending arm, intimate arrival, nearby foreground sliding as the camera sits down.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to arrive at a table, a secret, a song starting. Do not use it when you need a city to drop away.

blocks.text: Crane Down is the big cousin, tens of feet, map becoming a person. Jib Up is the reverse small lift.
A Tilt Down only pitches from sticks. Jib down translates a short arm.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Music videos and small-set drama are the grammar: intimate sit-downs, a guest arriving at a table. The still is the end of the sit-down, not a skyline.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a tilt down. The tell: the support never moved, no foreground shear.
The fix: a short descending arm, nearby objects sliding, human-scale arrival.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Jib Down in film?
A jib down is a short descending crane arm, a few feet of boom, arriving at a person with nearby foreground sliding. Intimate, not city-scale.
Jib Down vs Crane Down
A crane down can drop from rooftops or hills. A jib down is a small arm sitting into a table, a face, or a huddle.
When should I use Jib Down?
Use it to sit down into a talk or a song. Do not use it when a fortress or a skyline must fall away.
How do I prompt Jib Down for AI image or video?
Write a short descending arm and sliding foreground. Example: Jib down onto [Subject], a short descending arm, intimate arrival, nearby foreground sliding as the camera sits down.
